ITEM.PTXT: A control that quickly removes pollen around the faces of front seat occupants by simply pressing the pollen removal switch on the air conditioning control panel, without complicated air conditioning adjustments, is used.

When the pollen removal switch located in the air conditioning control panel is operated, the operation indicator light comes on, the air conditioning computer selects recirculation mode and Face outlet mode, and clean air that has passed through the clean air filter is blown toward the occupants' faces. In addition, pollen in the cabin is captured by the clean air filter.

Pollen removal control automatically returns to normal control after 3 minutes under normal conditions, or after 1 minutes when the outside air temperature is low. Pollen removal control is also canceled by pressing the pollen removal switch, the AUTO switch, or an outlet mode switch (including the DEF switch) during pollen removal control.
When the outside air temperature is low, the system does not switch to forced recirculation mode.
A push type air conditioner control panel is provided as standard in the integration panel.
A pollen removal switch has been provided in the air conditioner control panel. Pressing the switch activates pollen removal mode, quickly removing pollen around the face.

On G grade models with the independent right/left temperature control system (dual mode), separate temperature setting switches for the driver side and front passenger side are provided on the air conditioner control section, together with a DUAL switch for switching from linked control to independent right/left temperature control.
